author: Laura O'Driscoll, with Sam Illingworth
locators: L100–108, What to do with it
basis: First-person repeated-use account and proposed prompt
reported_outcomes: O’Driscoll describes questions that paused her thinking and says some positions changed; no independent assessment.
proposed_outcomes: Examine assumptions and the reasons for holding a belief.
limits: Questions can embed a false premise about upbringing, motives or emotion.
Felt insight is not evidence that a revised belief is true.
review_note: Retain the human answers and tension sentence; do not frame the model as an authority on the origin of beliefs.
coverage: Close-read all 186 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
